hull.material: acrylic, polycarbonate or aluminium (non-magnetic, never steel)
hull.holes: none: the dock is glued on the outside

vent_slot.why: water leaves when the plug goes in and comes back when it is pulled: no hydraulic lock, no suction

dock.base: flat for a box hull; saddle for a tube hull (hull_r in dock_plug.scad)
dock.glue: 2-part epoxy or acrylic cement for an acrylic hull

magnet.why: the A3144 on the KY-003 switches only on a south pole at its printed face; if the HALL LED stays off with the plug in, turn the magnet round

plug.flag: red REMOVE TO KILL flag on the lanyard

retention.how: the O-ring snaps into the dock's detent groove; no steel latch (a magnetised steel part near the sensors could hold one on)
retention.check: pull it with a luggage scale: it must let go between 10 and 20 N; change the O-ring cord or hardness to tune

bracket.glued_to: inside of the hull wall, centred on the dock axis
bracket.mc38_seat: on top of the plate, 1.6 mm off the wall, so it also clamps the A3144 flat
bracket.plate_extent: 58 mm along the wall: 30 mm on the KY-003 side of the axis, 28 mm on the MC-38 side

hall.placement: A3144 legs bent so its printed face lies flat on the wall, on the axis

reed.module: MC-38 wired part (normally open, closes with the magnet)
reed.placement: body parallel to the wall, long side pointing at the axis, reed centre 12 mm off axis
reed.why_off_axis: a reed lying flat across the axis sees opposite field on its two halves: null on the axis
reed.note: the MC-38 body (27.5 mm) reaches over the axis, so it sits on the 1.6 mm plate and the A3144 lies in the window under its end

inside.alignment: with the plug in, slide the bracket until HALL and REED LEDs are both solidly on, mark it, then glue

cables.hall: twisted 3-wire from the KY-003 to J3 (1 = S, 2 = +, 3 = -)
cables.reed: twisted 2-wire from the MC-38 to J4 (either way round)
cables.battery: battery + and - (30 A cont / 60 A burst) as a twisted pair, at least 10 cm from the sensors; 40 A fuse in the + lead

files.scad: dock_plug.scad (part = dock | plug | handle | bracket | all; hull_r > 0 gives the dock a saddle for a tube hull)
files.stl: dock.stl, plug.stl, handle.stl, bracket.stl: exported with OpenSCAD 2021.01 from dock_plug.scad as it is (flat hull, hull_r = 0)
